_comment: Armor set bonuses (see armorset/SetBonuses.java). Wear enough matching Arsenal armor pieces and the set's effects
switch on; take one off and they stop. Several sets can be on at once. The Shipwright's Manual's Set Bonuses
chapter is written from this file, so change the numbers here and the book follows.
pieces = how many of the four (hat, coat, sash, boots) must match. 4 = a full set.
shell / lining = what each matching piece's shell or lining must be made of: a faction (pirate, navy or shared)
and/or a list of material ids. Leave one out and that part can be anything.
attribute: attribute id, amount, operation (add_value, add_multiplied_base or add_multiplied_total).
mob_effect: effect id and amplifier (0 = level I), kept on while the set is worn.
damage_taken: from = devil_fruit_users, projectiles, fire, marines or pirates. amount = share taken off (0.3 = 30% less).
damage_dealt: against = devil_fruit_users, marines, pirates or sea_creatures. amount = share added (0.1 = 10% more).
disguise_bounty: amount = how many times the bounty your Marine uniform can hide (2 = twice as much).
suspicion: amount = how fast watching Marines get suspicious (0.5 = half as fast).
All damage_taken cuts together never take off more than 60% of a hit.
